currentRoundInspection.method: Two roof/facade photographs inspected in browser and compared with standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke survey research or redistributed photograph.

pictures.observations: Northwest-looking church overview: unequal western Rotunda/eastern Catholicon domes, tall square paired-arch bell tower with red hipped cap, two-level arched south facade, connected roof terraces, two roof stair flights and smaller rounded eastern chapel roofs. Earlier roof condition/colors differ from the newer view.

Newer roof/facade view: both principal domes have gray segmented metal; broad western crown/lantern and smaller eastern gold cross. Bell tower has paired open belfry arches, intermediate arcade and red tile hip. Limestone facade has paired lower portal heads, large upper round arches/grille panes, broad cornice and terrace rail. Small cream front cupola and shallow eastern apse roofs remain distinct. Exact lettering/sculpture and full door interiors are not reconstructed.
